source.note: workspace/ is the tree exported with `git archive` at the defective-side commit, which contains both llm_judge_reward (the pairwise path this task exercises) and llm_judge_equiv_reward. The recorded job's own git commit (53528f481437 on branch dev-minicpm-pyx) is not present in this local clone and could not be fetched; the entry runs `cd <worktree> && bash <script>`, so the pod used a working tree rather than the platform checkout. No metric value anywhere in this task was altered.

replacements.reason: The recorded launch command passed --judge-api-key in cleartext. The entry line is not shipped; task.toml's training.script_args reproduces the run's flags with the credential omitted.
Third-party endpoint of the recorded run; omitted from script_args because it is not part of the defect and the judge is supplied by the harness.
The template was an out-of-repo asset referenced by absolute path. It is now shipped inside workspace/ and referenced relatively, so the task is self-contained.
Absolute user path, and the control arm's CKPT_PATH carries a '-gtequiv-kl' suffix that names the fix and would reveal which side is which. No CKPT_PATH is shipped.

The recorded image is private and cannot be pulled publicly. The shipped issue tier reads only frozen evidence and starts no training, so the shared public slime v0.3.2 stack is used instead. The launch script has not been smoke-tested against this substituted image.
Absolute user path. The underlying directory has been deleted, so no usable path exists to substitute.

remaining_scan_hits.detail: Occurrences are ordinary English and identifier names in the upstream miles tree (tests, docs, argument names). workspace/miles/rollout/rm_hub/ -- the directory holding the defect -- has zero hits, so none of these labels indicate which arm this workspace is.
Submodule URLs in workspace/.gitmodules plus unrelated upstream scripts and docs. They are properties of the framework tree, not of the recorded run, and do not reveal the defect.

remaining_scan_hits.verdict: upstream launch-script defaults, left in place
remaining_scan_hits.detail: These absolute paths are defaults in the upstream miles launch script (run-minicpm5-26b-short-math-8k-colocate.sh). They name model/data/checkpoint locations, do not identify which arm produced this workspace, and no metric value or root cause depends on them.

omitted_from_workspace.reason: Git submodules; present as empty directories in the export. Not vendored, matching reward/slime_retool_length_reward_bonus which ships only the framework package.
Per CONTRIBUTING: weights are never shipped in the task.

The rollout dumps for this job were deleted before packaging, so the literal one-token completions could not be included. The collapse is evidenced by the per-step response-length and reward trace instead.

control_arm_note.confounding: The control differs from the defective run in three simultaneous changes: --rm-type (llm_judge -> llm_judge_equiv), --judge-prompt-template (A/B pairwise -> GT-equiv), --kl-loss-coef (absent -> 0.001). No single-variable contrast is available, which is why this task ships issue-only.
